Refitting

Removing

- Clean the contact areas between the engine block and the cylinder head thoroughly.

Cover the cylinder liners/bores and pistons to prevent the penetration of impurities or foreign bodies.

- Place the cylinder head centering bushes on the cylinder block.

- Fit a new cylinder head gasket taking care to ensure that it is the same size as the one removed.

Position the first cylinder at T.D.C.; rotate the crankshaft a further two teeth of the toothed timing drive pulley to lower the pistons thereby preventing any interference with the valves whilst fitting the cylinder head.

- Position the cylinder head on the cylinder block/crankcase.
